WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT st.region,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) AS month_start,
           SUM(s.units_sold) AS units
    FROM fmcg_sales AS s
    JOIN dim_store AS st ON s.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
    GROUP BY st.region, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(s.date AS DATE))
),
growth AS (
    SELECT region, month_start, units,
           LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_units

WHERE prev_units IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY region, month_start

WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT st.region,
           DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) AS week_start,
           SUM(s.units_sold) AS units
    FROM fmcg_sales AS s
    JOIN dim_store AS st ON s.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31'
    GROUP BY st.region, DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(s.date AS DATE))
),
growth AS (
    SELECT region, week_start, units,
           LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY week_start) AS prev_units
    FROM weekly
)
SELECT region, week_start, units, prev_units,
       (units - prev_units) AS wow_change
FROM growth
WHERE prev_units IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY wow_change DESC
LIMIT 10
